formats_detail: [{"format": "STL", "full_name": "Stereolithography", "file_size": "706 KB", "file_count": 3, "version": null, "renderer": null}]
description_text:
Shark Fin and Tail - Creative Decoration - STL Printable
To be used as decorative item.You can paint it as your favorite shark (gray, black tip, etc).You can print a single one, or a few of them and create like a group of sharks.
The idea here is a simple creative decoration that interacts very well with your table or where you place it, making it looks like a water surface.
This size is pre-set as: Shark Fin: 93,5x50x33mmShark Tail: 31x21x13mmBut you can resize it as you prefer to create bigger or smaller sharks.
I also set two files inside, one separatedly (fin and tail) and one with both of them together, in case you can print two items.
I didn't test it in a 3D printer, so let me know if you have any trouble with it.
Feel free to share your printed model with me, it would be a pleasure to see the final result of your work :)And please, do not share my STL file for free in STL groups, I set it cheap so any1 can have access to it, and its how I pay my bills :)

In the exploration of 3D printing applications to help nature, here is the latest find.
The Bee Hotel

The utility of this model is the preservation of pollenisers, key players in biodiversity.
Solitary bees build their nests by themselves and lay their eggs in tunnels, such as dead wood or hard soil.
The Bee Hotel mimics these conditions.

Easy to make this model is designed to be printed without support.
Height 140 mm
Width 90 mm
depth 120 mm

Then, it remains only to fill the interior with hollow plant stems (bamboo, reed, etc ...)
Your house of bees must be placed in full sun, facing south-east or south.
You can suspend it (do not swing it too much, avoid the branches) or hang it on a screw (6 mm diameter).
A southern exposure is recommended.

description_text:
After the discovery of the Hex Crystals and the realization that the Miles had been exploited by alien races since long before they arrived, the Star Pharaohs were forced to devote more time to recovering their stolen Hex Crystals than mining the Miles as their programming demanded. The solution was to develop a dedicated group of mining drones, much as their creators the Makers had done with the Star Pharaohs themselves. The Skorp Swarms turned out to be so efficient and effective that they are even able to join the Star Pharaohs in battle between mining shifts. Don’t let their cute appearance fool you- their pincers are able to squeeze asteroids into nanodiamonds and the antimatter beams on their tails can cut through the most powerful alien foes like fabric. Unlike the Makers, the Star Pharaohs stick by their creations, and the Skorp Swarms serve as an invaluable ally to their creators. 
Skorp Swarms fit on a 40mm base (3 Skorps can fit on a base) and serve as a great proxy for fast attack units in 28mm scifi wargaming.

description_text:
This design is inspired by the meditative sight of an insect flying over a lake and repeatedly touching the surface of the water. On the lake forms a pattern of circles that flow into each other. They are connected by the fly's trajectory. 
This ring is design>comfort as it is relatively thick at 6mm. But of course you can get used to that. Then you have an absolutely unusual piece of jewelry.  
The circles are 1.4mm thick and between 11 and 5.7mm wide. They are connected by wire bridges, each 1/3 thick (3.6 - 1.9mm). At the widest point the ring is 16.5mm wide. Volume: 1332 cubic millimeters. You can scale the ring to fit your finger. Suitable for 3D printing (such as sls, sla, fdm) and wax casting.
As a trained goldsmith with years of experience in 3D design, I work with great care. If something does not fit, please feel free to contact me.
If my designs inspire you contact me for your personal ideas.

description_text:
Hello,
Here is my latest model V2 Sci Fi Bug  (one of more to come). I thought id try a mecha sci fi bug design and this is what I made over the last week. Built in zbrush with no concept as usual - original designs. I initially made the legs too thin so had to rebuild with sturdy thicker set design which actually made it look better imo. I made lots of sunken panel designs around the model and set planes at angles to look aerodynamic and also catch the light from different angles. The images are mostly renders and I have added 3 photos of the raw print. Raw being snipped off suppports but have yet to trim off some support tips. You can only just see them in the photos. I printed this on my elegoo mars 3 with water washable resin with default settings. Auto supports and some extras I added where needed. I tilted the nose end up about 15-20 degrees. Took about 2.5 hours on default. Hope you like it and thanks to all who buy my models. Looks great in chrome too!If you need any help just send a message and I will reply promptly.
The size is103.27mm X62.82mm Y120mm Z
(Please note * The photos of the print show the size flat on the build plate which was printed at the reduced size AT 75%)77.45mm X47.12mm Y90.00mm  Z
ThanksCalum

KAWS is an American graffiti artist and designer known for his toys, paintings, and prints. Pop Art and culture permeate his cartoonish Companion series of figurines, which bear a resemblance to the works of Takashi Murakami. KAWS is a multi-faceted artist straddling the worlds of art and design in his prolific body of work that ranges from paintings, murals, and large-scale sculptures to product design and toy-making. His iconic “XX” signature has its roots in the beginning of his career as a street artist in the 1990s, when he began altering found advertisements by incorporating his own masterful paintings. Evoking the sensibilities of Pop artists like Andy Warhol and Claes Oldenburg, KAWS possesses a sophisticated humor and thoughtful interplay with consumer products and collaborations with global brands. He often draws inspiration and appropriates from popular culture animations to form a unique artistic vocabulary and influential cast of hybrid cartoon and human characters.

Additional Notes:
This model was created for 5 hours form our Leading 3D artists to ensure you get the best quality model and save precious production time.
If you have any questions, you can contact us through support. Just send a support ticket!

description_text: The famous assasin from Dune, specifically Denis Villenuve's 2021 remake. The hunter seeker was a small motion based assasin that would hover through the air emmiting a high pitched noise until it detected motion at which point it would fly toward it piercing the target with a poisoned needle. I recreated this from scratch based off of various drawings as well as shots from the movie and descrptions from the frist book. The model is rigged and ready for use in animations, games, and almost anything else. It is fairly lowpoly with the heaviest part being the textures. The textures may or may not pack correctly, if they dont, basic image textures will suffice for the most part. I wasn't able to link the textures I used for legal reasons but packing them into the file was allowed.

description_text:
Discover our cutters, we have a wide variety, with several sizes to choose from. They can be worn on casual occasions or even for professional use.
All cutters are made with a sharp, tapered tip, easily cutting through soft materials. On the other hand, they have an edge to make them firmer and less flexible.
The cutters can be used to make cookies, jewelry, small decorations, candies, etc.
Printing Tips:

  - Do not use nozzles larger than 0.4. Sometimes it is necessary to use 0.05mm horizontal compensation.

  - Smaller dimensions, easier to print in resin. But they work perfectly in FDM.

Usage Tips:

  - We recommend that the thickness of the dough is around 5 mm (~ 1/5 inch). Especially in dough cutters with details that only appear if the dough is more than 2mm.

  - For prettier cookies, follow a yeast-free recipe.

  - If you use flour and chilled dough you can get better results.

  - If it is to make jewelry, 2.5cm or 3cm is usually used. If your goal is to make cookies you should choose between 5-8cm. With small cutting edges it is more difficult to make details.

description_text:
Tarantulas comprise a group of large and often hairy spiders of the family Theraphosidae. 
As of December 2023, 1,100 species have been identified, with 166 genera.
The term tarantula is usually used to describe members of the family Theraphosidae, although many other members of the same infraorder (Mygalomorphae) are commonly referred to as tarantulas or false tarantulas. Some of the more common species have become popular in the exotic pet trade. 
Many New World species kept as pets have setae known as urticating hairs that can cause irritation to the skin, and in extreme cases, cause damage to the eyes.
The Tarantula dimensions are the following (mm): 
Height- 30
Width- 190
Depth- 188
Sculpting software used: Blender
Render method used for the previews: Cycles
Filament: PLA
Slicer used to 3D print: Ultimaker Cura
Settings I've used to 3D print:
Standard quality - 0.2mm
Infill - 20%
Supports - No supports should be needed
Speed - 50% first 20 layers and 100% for the rest
Plate Adhesion - Skirt
Cooling - Enabled
Travel - Retraction Enabled

description_text:
Designed from scratch is an insect repellent light, as a single piece, high in detail, ideal for scale modeling (currently in 1/24 and 1/25 scale).
Perfect for those dioramas & vignets!
2 versions provided, with the front mech and without.
If printing with the mesh;The light must be angled slightly rearwards & sideways to allow the thin mesh to print with supports, or print as normal and allow the supports to damage the mesh to give a beaten up look. 
If printing without the mesh;Print as normal and add your own mesh (1:1 insect screen etc) in front.
The light has 3 round holes on 1 side and an internal locator on the other side, to paint your light elements separately and thread them through - sample pics provided in the MAKE tab of the listing.
At 1/24 scale (AS-IS), use 1.2mm round rod
Be sure to tag @mattys_custom_scale on Instagram with your finished prints & projects!
Intended for personal use, not to be redistributed without consent

description_text:
OverviewHigh-quality Beehive Entrance Platform with an adjustable gate designed for standard German beehives (DN/Zander/Dadant compatibility notes below). The landing board improves take-off/landing, while the height-adjustable entrance reducer lets you fine-tune ventilation, traffic flow, and pest protection across seasons.
Key Features
Adjustable entrance gate: set multiple opening heights for winter/summer and night protection.
German standard ready: dimensions planned around common DN/Zander/Dadant front widths (see sizing).
Outdoor-oriented design: filleted edges, drainage-friendly shapes, PETG/ASA recommended.
Print-friendly: no complex supports, 0.2 mm layer height friendly, robust walls for outdoor use.
Customizable: scale slightly to match your hive face; includes clear dimensional diagram.
Use Cases
Reduce robbing and control pests at the Flugloch (hive entrance).
Seasonal ventilation control and traffic management.
Easy landing for foragers; safer night-time reduction.
What’s Included
3mf  (watertight, manifold) + OBJ/FBX on request.
Dimension sheet (PNG/JPG) with key distances and suggested print settings.
Readme (PDF): assembly, mounting, maintenance.
Sizing & Compatibility
Designed to fit the front face of German hives (DN/Zander/Dadant); entrance width is adjustable via the gate.
Units: millimeters. Model at 1:1 scale.
Minor scaling (±2–3%) is acceptable to match brand-specific hive tolerances.
Print Recommendations
Material: PETG/ASA (outdoor/UV), ABS if protected; PLA not recommended for long-term outdoor use.
Layer height: 0.2 mm; Walls: 3–4 perimeters; Infill: 20–35%; Top/Bottom: 4–6 layers.
Orientation: gate rails horizontal; landing surface face-up; supports minimal/optional.
Hardware: stainless screws if you plan permanent mounting (not included).
License & Usage
Personal Use: unlimited prints for your own apiary.
Commercial Use (optional upgrade): limited production runs for small shops; contact for extended terms/branding.

Predator Dog STL file optimized for FDM-FFF DLP-SLA-SLS printinginspired by the film, THE PREDATOR, from 2018
3 versions File, for FDM, For SLA, for SLShowever, the dimensions can be changed with each slicer
in total is composed of 5.448 mil pointsall the files have been decimated by the polygons, but without losing the details, this makes the light files suitable for each computer

all files are already in place for optimal printing 
Predator Dog 3D model was designed to get a clean print result, without considering printing material consumption, However, you are free to rotate, or scale, every part of the model in the most convenient way for you.Each file has been checked and repaired with NetfabbThe parts of the model are already positioned for 3D printingCompatible with every Slicer- Simplify3D, Care, Slic3r, etc ...All the parts of the model have been cut so as to be printed vertically, for a higher quality of printing
Recommended settings for printing
each part was cut to be printed vertically, to have a better quality print, so for the upper parts, it is recommended to print with a 4-5 skirt

description_text:
Bring a little charm and movement to your collection with this Articulated Ladybug. Designed as a flexible print-in-place model, this adorable insect features a segmented body that bends and wiggles smoothly straight off the print bed.
The model is optimized for reliable FDM printing and requires no assembly. Carefully designed joints provide satisfying movement while maintaining durability, making it an excellent fidget toy, desk companion, collectible figure, or small gift.

Perfect For:• Fidget toy enthusiasts• Desk accessories• Insect and nature lovers• Children's toys• Stress-relief toys• Collectible articulated animals• Handmade gifts• 3D printing hobbyists

Print it in classic red and black colors for a traditional ladybug appearance, or experiment with custom filaments and color combinations to create your own unique version.

description_text: This isn't textured, Its just a basic 3d model in a scene for lighting. The obj and fbx files dont come with the scene. The scene is just a light and a platform with a camera and the dog/fox. Note that this is shaded smooth, but can be subdivided and modified if you want to make it smoother. I have the blender file which is the scene and the fbx file and the obj file. I beleive the obj file cannot be animated. The fbx file comes with the bones. Its meant to be user friendly as possible! .Blend files work in some versions of unity, ususually newer versions. Fbx files also work in most versions of unity. Not tested in unreal engine. If you need to, you can open this in blender and un-subdivide it and it will still look pretty good. Contact me if you have any questions, I am very flexible with any questions! You can contact me for a low poly version if you need it.

description_text:
High poly Sculpture of Dinosaur Skeleton. Skeleton created in Zbrush. Also it has Muscle System, Skin, and 2D preview. This product only includes Skeleton of Dinosaur. This model was created by carefully studying image references(dinosaur leopard, dog, rabbit, cat) videos and books on equine anatomy. Although great effort was put to make it accurate, please be advised that this model MAY NOT be 100% anatomically correct.
Here is some questions to get to know the unique dinosaur:
Where do they live?They tend to live in the cold so they are living cold areas like snowy weather. That's why they mostly live in the poles, they can not live with warm or hot weather.
What are the colors?They have mostly black feathers. Feathers are shiny and silvery
What do they eat?They are carnivorous. With a few exceptions, they are not feed except meat. For example, they eat grass when their stomach hurts or if they are very hungry and they can not find any meat, they will eat snow with the living things in the soil.
How are the physical properties?They have 4 legs, their hind legs are longer than their front legs (no big difference), 2 sharp tails from the same root.
How are their measurements?When they stand on their back 2 feet, adult males are about 2 meters tall and adult females are around 1.8 meters tall.
What is its lifespan? They live an average of 15 years. After a certain age, they cannot resist because they lose their strength and agility over time.
Do they live as groups or singles?They usually live as a couple. Sometimes they live alone or with their children.
How do they mate?They show their desire for the opposite by dancing with their tails and they mate like dogs.
Which animal do they look like the most except dinosaur?Their features and looks similar to snow leopard.
Are they aggressive like leopards?They are definitely aggressive like leopards. maybe even more aggressive than they are. If they are sure that they can beat their opponent, they will not avoid a fight.
What are the strengths?They are agile like a cat, they have an average dinosaur strength, they can easily fight the toughest colds, they can get under the snow and dig. They are so fast on the snow. They also have leopard claws. They can be camouflaged with their light fluffs in harmony with the snow.
What are the weak points?They cannot cope with hot climates. Since they sleep deeply, they can be attacked during sleep. They are slow on non-snow surfaces.
How would you rate thier strengths out of 10?Agility = 9/10, Strength = 7/10, Cold Resistance = 10/10, Dig = 9/10, Fast on snow = 9/10, Ability to Smell = 7/10, Camouflage = 8/10.
Do they have fluff? Yes, they have thick and shiny fluff.
Can they be domesticated?They cannot be tamed like a cat but can be trained like a lion.
Can they swim?Yes, but swimming skills are not very developed. Although they are weak in water, thanks to their lung chambers, they can hold their breath for a long time.
Can they climb trees?They cannot climb because there are not many trees in the areas where they live, so they have not adapted to climb trees.
How they move?They move by using all 4 legs. When necessary, they can stand like humans with their long hind legs.
How do they defend themselves?They defend themselves with piercing teeth, agile and powerful movements and pointed claws.
What is their favorite thing to do?Dancing before mating. While they dance, they dance wonderfully by cooperating with their tails and bodies.
Do they more choose to run, fight or hide?They can do it all. It’s all about their conditions and enverionment.
How does it sound?Mix of roaring and moaning. Scary but not annoying sound.
Are they charismatic animal?Definetly yes. Although they look a little weird, they are so cool.

description_text:
Voronoi Dome made with grasshopper plugin in Rhino 3D. Dinosaurs and people are not included.
About Voronoi:In mathematics, a Voronoi diagram is a partition of a plane into regions close to each of a given set of objects. It can be classified also as a tessellation. In the simplest case, these objects are just finitely many points in the plane (called seeds, sites, or generators). For each seed there is a corresponding region, called a Voronoi cell, consisting of all points of the plane closer to that seed than to any other. The Voronoi diagram of a set of points is dual to that set's Delaunay triangulation.
The Voronoi diagram is named after mathematician Georgy Voronoy, and is also called a Voronoi tessellation, a Voronoi decomposition, a Voronoi partition, or a Dirichlet tessellation (after Peter Gustav Lejeune Dirichlet). Voronoi cells are also known as Thiessen polygons, after Alfred H. Thiessen.[1][2][3] Voronoi diagrams have practical and theoretical applications in many fields, mainly in science and technology, but also in visual art.

3D Printable Assembly Model
This highly detailed 3D printable dinosaur skeleton merges prehistoric charm with mechanical style! Inspired by small theropods like Velociraptors, the model features realistic bones with bolt-like joints for full articulation. Each part is designed to be printed separately and assembled easily—making it perfect for education, collecting, or home decor.
Whether you're a STEM educator, dino enthusiast, or maker, this model offers a rewarding build with professional results on both FDM and SLA printers. Thanks to its modular construction, it prints cleaner, assembles smoother, and displays beautifully!
Technical Information
File Formats Included: STL, OBJ, FBX, GLB, USD
Printer Compatibility: FDM and SLA
Structure: Multi-part, articulated model
Layer Height: 0.1 mm or finer recommended
Infill: 20–30%
Supports: Needed for tail, skull base, rib gaps, and overhangs
Suggested Orientation: Depends on each part – mostly horizontal or angled
Ideal Size: Minimum 20 cm assembled length
Safety: No sharp tips, but not suitable for children under 3 due to small parts

description_text:
The 3D Spider Guard is an advanced Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (BJJ) position that takes the traditional spider guard to the next level by creating more dynamic control over your opponent’s posture and limbs. In this position, you typically place one or both of your feet on your opponent's biceps or hips while gripping their sleeves, pants, or collar (depending on the rule set). The key difference from traditional spider guard is the elevation and angling of your legs, which allows you to create a three-dimensional structure of control.
In a 3D Spider Guard, you maintain heavy tension on your opponent’s arms and body by using your legs to push, pull, and elevate while constantly changing angles. This creates a versatile, fluid attacking platform that can transition into sweeps, submissions (like the spider guard armbar or triangle), and submissions like collar chokes, depending on your opponent's reactions.
The position is incredibly effective against opponents who are trying to break posture or establish grips themselves. The added elevation and leg positioning give you increased leverage and control, making it more difficult for your opponent to disengage or counter.
When executed properly, the 3D Spider Guard gives you a strong foundation for both sweeping your opponent or setting up submission attacks, while maintaining the flexibility to adapt to their movements. It’s a highly technical guard that requires precision and timing to master.

description_text:
This high-energy 3D print model fuses a rebellious iguana with the punk rock aesthetic of Spider-Punk, delivering a one-of-a-kind superhero rockstar figure. With a microphone in one hand and a web-slinging pose, it blends attitude and action for a standout collectible.
Model Features:
Animal and Character Fusion: A roaring iguana head with sharp teeth, scaled textures, and edgy punk sunglasses creates a fierce yet stylish persona. Its expressive face merges perfectly with the Spider-Punk spirit.
Outfit and Accessories: The classic red-and-blue Spider-Man suit is punk-modified with unique textures and details. The spider emblem and web pattern offer instant recognition, while gold chains around the neck, metallic wrist accessories, and chain shoelaces enhance the rockstar flair. One hand slings a web, while the other grips a mic mid-scream.
Pose and Energy: Positioned with one foot forward in a power stance, the iguana appears mid-performance and mid-battle. The energetic pose conveys stage charisma and combat readiness, making it a vibrant post-print display centerpiece.
Color and Detail: Bright red and blue dominate the suit, contrasting with the grey-scaled iguana features. Gold chains and mic accents add polish. Scales, web textures, and accessories are modeled for high-detail prints.
Print Compatibility: Provided in STL, OBJ, FBX, GLB, and USD formats. Optimized for multi-part printing and ideal for both FDM and resin printers.
Can be printed on full-color 3D printers.
The Iguana Spider-Punk model brings a rebellious twist to the superhero genre, perfect for fans of Spider-Man, reptiles, and punk rock energy. A true statement piece for any unique collection.

Hi there!
The Atlas moth (Attacus atlas) is one of the largest moth species in the world, found primarily in the tropical and subtropical forests of Southeast Asia. It features a wingspan that can reach up to 10-12 inches (25-30 cm) and has striking wing patterns with shades of brown, orange, and cream. The moth's unique wing shape is often likened to a snake’s head, which helps deter predators. Adult Atlas moths do not feed and typically live only a few weeks, focusing on reproduction.

description_text: This low-poly 3D model depicts a Dimetrodon, a prehistoric synapsid reptile that lived during the Early Permian period, approximately 295 to 272 million years ago. Often mistaken for a dinosaur, Dimetrodon is actually more closely related to mammals than to reptiles like lizards or dinosaurs. Its most iconic feature is the large, sail-like structure on its back, formed by elongated neural spines covered in skin, which may have been used for thermoregulation, display, or intimidation. This simplified yet anatomically recognizable model captures the creature’s robust body, powerful limbs, and distinctive sail, making it ideal for educational, gaming, or paleontological visualization projects.

description_text:
[NOTE:] This was originally published on my Shapeways store, tested using their printers. Tolerances may need to be adjusted.
This is a pair of replacement knees for PotP Grimlock that add more length to the thighs for better proportioned legs. This also has the benefit of adding range to his tail bend, which lets the dinosaur mode stand up straighter.
Installation involves the complete disassembly of the legs. Keep track of which screw comes from which hole because they can be slightly different sizes(the thigh screws in particular vary between the top and bottom hole). Afterwards you have to pop the tiny glue points loose on the lower legs by carefully prying them apart (IIRC they're in the front of the knee, the shin, and the back of the calf), which may snap a small connection peg or two off. This won't matter if you use a little bit of glue on these pegs when you reassemble the legs, which I recommend for a better closure.
Make sure the black combiner port clip is properly inserted and held in by your finger during reassembly. It has a little lip that needs to slip through the rectangular hole between the peg slots and grab the outer side slightly. This is extremely important if you want the combiner mode to still work.

description_text:
The leaves are borne alternately on the stem. In most species they are 5 to 15 centimetres (2.0 to 5.9 in) long, pinnate, with (3–) 5–9 (–13) leaflets and basal stipules; the leaflets usually have a serrated margin, and often a few small prickles on the underside of the stem. Most roses are deciduous but a few (particularly from Southeast Asia) are evergreen or nearly so.
The flowers of most species have five petals, with the exception of Rosa omeiensis and Rosa sericea, which usually have only four. Each petal is divided into two distinct lobes and is usually white or pink, though in a few species yellow or red. Beneath the petals are five sepals (or in the case of some Rosa omeiensis and Rosa sericea, four). These may be long enough to be visible when viewed from above and appear as green points alternating with the rounded petals. There are multiple superior ovaries that develop into achenes.[5] Roses are insect-pollinated in nature.
The aggregate fruit of the rose is a berry-like structure called a rose hip. Many of the domestic cultivars do not produce hips, as the flowers are so tightly petalled that they do not provide access for pollination. The hips of most species are red, but a few (e.g. Rosa pimpinellifolia) have dark purple to black hips. Each hip comprises an outer fleshy layer, the hypanthium, which contains 5–160 seeds (technically dry single-seeded fruits called achenes) embedded in a matrix of fine, but stiff, hairs. Rose hips of some species, especially the dog rose (Rosa canina) and rugosa rose (Rosa rugosa), are very rich in vitamin C, among the richest sources of any plant. The hips are eaten by fruit-eating birds such as thrushes and waxwings, which then disperse the seeds in their droppings. Some birds, particularly finches, also eat the seeds.
The sharp growths along a rose stem, though commonly called thorns, are technically prickles, outgrowths of the epidermis (the outer layer of tissue of the stem), unlike true thorns, which are modified stems. Rose prickles are typically sickle-shaped hooks, which aid the rose in hanging onto other vegetation when growing over it. Some species such as Rosa rugosa and Rosa pimpinellifolia have densely packed straight prickles, probably an adaptation to reduce browsing by animals, but also possibly an adaptation to trap wind-blown sand and so reduce erosion and protect their roots (both of these species grow naturally on coastal sand dunes). Despite the presence of prickles, roses are frequently browsed by deer. A few species of roses have only vestigial prickles that have no points.

description_text:
Jurassic Pet is a collection of Low-Poly animal theme! These models are mobile friendly and ready to use in render & in-game purposes.
The current model is the Deinocheirus mirificus
Features: 

  - Low Polygon 

  - Papercraft like style 

  - Rigged 

  - Animations: ♦ idle ♦ joyful ♦ walk

was made with 3DS Max 2016.
Quick Deinocheirus Facts

  - May have climbed trees like modern sloths

  - Deinocheirus is the largest bird mimic of all time

  - Weighs as much as an African Elephant

  - Was 3 car lengths long

  - Was as large as a Tyrannosaurus Rex

  - Had 10 inch claws and 8 foot long arms

About Deinocheirus
Deinocheirus was one of the most mysterious dinosaurs to have ever been found by paleontologists. It was originally found in 1965 in Southern Mongolia—actually, not the whole dinosaur was found but only its gigantic hands. And for the next 50 years, that is all that scientists would have of this elusive dinosaur. That is probably why its name means “terrible hand”.
That changed in 2012, when 3 paleontologists—Phil Bell, Yuong- Nam Lee and Philip J. Currie—discovered 2 new specimens that would reveal all of the secrets that this dinosaur once held. Secrets of its size and what it is believed to have eaten. Up until that point, the only thing that was really known about this dinosaur was that it had massive hands and lived about 70 million years ago during the late Cretaceous Period.
Deinocheirus was around 30 feet long, almost 15 feet high and weighed about 6 tons. It was a bipedal dinosaur—from a species called Ornithomimids, which are sometimes called ‘ostrich dinosaurs’ and was the biggest of these dinosaurs. However, it probably didn’t move like an ostrich. Due to its large size and weight, it more than likely lumbered along and didn’t run very quickly. I
It is believed that this dinosaur was a scavenger of sorts. It is believed to have eaten a variety of different things such as fish, invertebrates, plants and maybe even insects. It probably didn’t hunt prey like a predator. However, an interesting fact about this dinosaur is that it was probably frequently hunted by tyrannosaurus dinosaurs, as bite marks on its skeleton would suggest.

description_text:
Jurassic Pet is a collection of Low-Poly animal theme!These models are mobile friendly and ready to use in render & in-game purposes.
The current model is the T-Rex Hybrid Indominus
Features:

  - Low Polygon

  - Papercraft like style

  - Rigged

  - Animations: ♦ idle ♦ joyful ♦ walk♦ attack

was made with 3DS Max 2016.
About T-Rex Hybrid
The hybrid was created by combining the genetic traits of multiple species. Some of the known species that were used in the creation of the hybrid are Tyrannosaurus rex, Velociraptor, Carnotaurus, Giganotosaurus, Majungasaurus, Rugops, and Therizinosaurus as well as modern animals like cuttlefish, tree frogs, and a pit viper snake.
Its large size is attributed to Giganotosaurus. Interestingly, I. rex could reach 50 ft as an adult when none of the theropods, including Giganotosaurus, used in its creation could reach this length. The cause of this surpassed length in the hybrid is unknown.
The teeth of Indominus was tyrannosaurid which must have came from its base genome T. rex and were exposed like a crocodile. Due to this bit of instability, its teeth varied in size, often jutting out at unnatural angles and many were broken. Indominus rex had a total of 74 teeth. Another trait that came from Tyrannosaurus being in its gene pool was the massively strong bite force it had, which Indominus could use to even crush a bullet-proof Gyrosphere or break the neck of an Ankylosaurus. The Indominus' lower jaw was slightly longer than the upper jaw, which gave it something of an underbite.

description_text:
Jurassic Pet is a collection of Low-Poly animal theme! These models are mobile friendly and ready to use in render & in-game purposes.
The current model is the TroodonFeatures: 

  - Low Polygon 

  - Papercraft like style 

  - Rigged 

  - Animations:♦ idle♦ walk♦ joyful

Troodon is a small bird-like Theropod. It has very long legs with specialized feet, in which the middle long bone was pinched out at the top to form a shock-absorbing wedge. This allowed it to run very fast. Troodon had very large eyes that faced mostly forward, so that it could focus better. It is famous for having one of the largest brains (for its body size) of any dinosaur making it the most intelligent.
Troodon had a jaw full of many small teeth, but they were not like the teeth of typical meat-eaters. Instead of little serrations running up and down the back of the teeth (as in most meat-eaters), there were larger bumps running along the side, as in many plant-eating dinosaurs and lizards. Some paleontologists speculate that Troodon may have eaten not only small animals, lizards, and baby dinosaurs, but also insects, eggs, and even plants.
Paleontologist Dave Varricchio discovered the first Troodon nest. Like oviraptorosaurs and ground-dwelling birds, Troodon would make a nest on the ground. It would then curl up on top of the nest to brood its eggs

About Pterodactylus
Name: Pterodactylus ‭(‬Winged finger‭)‬.Phonetic: Teh-roe-dack-till-us ‭(‬The P is silent and not pronounced‭)‬.Named By: Georges Cuvier‭ ‬-1809.Synonyms: Diopecephalus kochi,‭ ‬Macrotrachelus longirostris,‭ ‬Ornithocephalus antiquus,‭ ‬O.‭ ‬brevirostris,‭ ‬O.‭ ‬kochi,‭ ‬O.‭ ‬longirostris,‭ ‬O.‭ ‬meyeri,‭ ‬O.‭ ‬redenbacheri,‭ ‬Ptenodracon brevirostris,‭ ‬Pterodactylus brevirostris,‭ ‬P.‭ ‬crocodilocephaloides,‭ ‬P.‭ ‬kochi,‭ ‬P.‭ ‬longirostris,‭ ‬P.‭ ‬meyeri,‭ ‬P.‭ ‬micronyx,‭ ‬P.‭ ‬nettecephaloides,‭ ‬P.‭ ‬pulchellus,‭ ‬P.‭ ‬redenbacheri,‭ ‬P.‭ ‬scolopaciceps,‭ ‬P.‭ ‬spectabilis,‭ ‬P.‭ ‬suevicus,‭ ‬Rhamphorhynchus scolopaciceps.Classification:Chordata,‭ ‬Reptilia,‭ ‬Pterosauria,‭ ‬Pterodactyloidea,‭ ‬Euctenochasmatia.Species: P.‭ ‬antiquus‭ (‬type‭)‬,‭ ‬possibly P.‭ ‬longicollum.Type: Piscivore/Insectivore.Size: Up to‭ ‬1.5‭ ‬meter wingspan.Known locations: Europe.‭ ‬Africa.Time period: Early Tithonian of the Jurassic.Fossil representation: Dozens of specimens,‭ ‬some showing complete skeletons with some even including impressions of soft tissue.
Pterodactylus has the honour of being the first pterosaur known to science,‭ ‬although the type of creature that it really was,‭ ‬was still largely unknown at the time of its discovery.‭ ‬Many scientists inferred that it was more like a bat,‭ ‬or something between a bat and a bird.‭ ‬Some even put forward the suggestion that it was actually a marine creature and suggested that the wings were actually flippers.       Time,‭ ‬along with new discoveries and further research eventually confirmed Pterodactylus as a flying reptile,‭ ‬but continuing incomplete knowledge and understanding of the group during the nineteenth century resulted in many discoveries being attributed to Pterodactylus as different species of the genus.‭ ‬To cause even further confusion,‭ ‬it was also not known that Pterodactylus individuals varied considerably with age,‭ ‬with the result that Pterodactylus juveniles and sub adults were incorrectly named as different species.       Studies towards the end of the twentieth century have not only successfully reduced the number of species,‭ ‬they have also identified clear yearly growth cycles.‭ ‬Currently the only universally accepted species is the type Pterodactylus antiquus.‭ ‬The only other strong contender is P.‭ ‬longicollum which represents a larger and longer necked individual that also has fewer teeth.‭ ‬P.‭ ‬longicollum may yet represent a separate genus,‭ ‬meaning that its future inclusion as a Pterodactylus species is by no means certain.
